reason: The hypothesis combines the known detrimental effect of Mn diffusion (P1, P18) with the known beneficial effect of Si on oxidation (P12) and the mechanism of slow-diffusing elements suppressing void formation (P37, P38) to propose a specific substitution (Mn→Si) in CrFeCoNiX that promotes a dual Al2O3/Cr2O3 layer, an idea not stated in any passage. It transfers the 'slow diffuser improves adhesion' concept from yttrium in superalloys to Si in HEAs and links it to a testable comparison, going beyond the literature.
